The '''Sisterhood of the Beatific Countenance''' was a [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]-based religious order that was active [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. They were an all-[[Gender/Legends|female]] organization, with lines of scriptures [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on their bodies and wearing [[Color/Legends|blood-red]], [[Limb/Legends|ankle]]-length [[Robe/Legends|robes]] attached to screens that hid their skin and faces whenever they left the temple. The Sisterhood had one member, [[Seib Nod]], leave several years before 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. Nod stole several artifacts from the Sisterhood and was thinking to sell the items on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] while wearing the Sisterhood's robe and mask to disguise her [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] intentions. [[Archaeologist/Legends|Archaeologist]] [[Artuo Pratuhr]] was interested in buying the items, although Nod robbing him ultimately resulted in her [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] in the [[CoCo Penitentiary]], while Pratuhr returned the artifacts to the Sisterhood.

==Description==
[[File:SeibNob.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Seib Nod, who wore the Sisterhood's outfit even after she had left the order]]
The Sisterhood of the Beatific Countenance was a religious order based on<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="db">{{DB|character|seibnod|Nod, Seib}}</ref> [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]].<ref name="CSWE" /> An all-[[Gender/Legends|female]] organization, the Sisterhood had lines of scriptures [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on their bodies. When traveling outside their temple,<ref name="db" /> they wore [[Color/Legends|blood-red]], [[Limb/Legends|ankle]]-length [[Robe/Legends|robes]] attached to unique facial screens that hid their faces.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] and masks were worn to hide their skin. The Sisterhood's name was shared with<ref name="db" /> the [[Beatific Countenance]], one of two aspects of the [[God/Legends|goddess]] [[Via]], worshipped by followers of [[Vianism]].<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>

==History==
The Sisterhood was active [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">{{CSWECite|II|386|Nod, Seib}} mentions [[Seib Nod]] had left the Sisterhood of the Beatific Countenance [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before she visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. {{Film|II}} shows Nod in the Outlander Club concurrently to the entry, and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the events of that film take place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> One of the Sisterhood's members, [[Seib Nod]], grew bored with the organization's cloistered lifestyle, so she stole several of the temple's precious artifacts and left Lorrd.<ref name="db" /> Years after leaving, in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> she was present on<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> the planet<ref name="aotcvis">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="aotc" /> thinking about profiting by selling the Sisterhoood of the Beatific Countenance's stolen relics and still wearing her outfit from the Sisterhood to disguise her [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] intentions. [[Archaeologist/Legends|Archaeologist]] [[Artuo Pratuhr]] was interested in buying the items, and Nod addressed his suspicions by assuring him the Sisterhood had authorized the sale to raise desperately needed [[Currency/Legends|funds]] but wanted to keep it quiet to hide their dire situation.<ref name="db" />

Ultimately, Nod chose to rob Pratuhr, although she was ultimately caught while trying to escape. Pratuhr returned the Sisterhood of the Beatific Countenance's stolen artifacts back to the organization, and Nod was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in the [[CoCo Penitentiary]]. The Sisterhood pardoned her<ref name="db" /> while she served a lengthy sentence.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] member [[Captain Yossarian]] created the Sisterhood of the Beatific Countenance when he wrote Seib Nod's entry for [[StarWars.com]]'s Hyperspace feature "[[What's The Story?]],"<ref name="db" /> published in [[2008]].<ref name="jcf">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28246880|board=Literature|thread=Official "What's the Story?"
